text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: OrchidAI (acct: ORCH-34) reached out — product analytics team wants to spin up a new 'Search & Relevance' POC. Expected ~10k reqs/day to start, could ramp toward ~120k/day within 6 weeks. They want embeddings + rerank + realtime gen. Asking for guidance on latency SLOs and pricing. cc @kevin_serving

kevin_serving: Nice signal. Do they want hosted or dedicated? For 120k/day with embeddings+rerank realtime, we'd recommend Dedicated or Dedicated + burst. Need to pick model sizes — semi-large embed model + 7B gen might fit the latency/cost tradeoff. @anjali_success can we offer a short PoV config?

anjali_success: I can run onboarding + enablement. Need their expected token mix and a 24h traffic sample. Maria — can you grab their top-3 prompt templates and one-day sample logs? We'll prep a runbook and a short enablement deck. Also can demo batching/caching knobs.

tom_sales: Chiming in — renewal for ORCH-34 is Q4. This is a great expansion/upsell opportunity. If they commit to reserved capacity we can price it attractive. Maria, can you intro me to their head of platform so I can scope a commercial?

maria_cs: Intro sent (email + calendar). They asked: 'can we ensure sub-200ms p95 on gen + rerank at 100k qps/day?' Any quick guidance?

kevin_serving: Sub-200ms p95 is possible but depends on retrieval size and sequence lengths. If we pin short sequences, enable continuous batching, and use prefix/KV caching, gen p95 can be <200ms on Dedicated for a 7B-ish model. Rerank is usually cheaper if we do batched vector ops; end-to-end depends on retrieval latency. Hosted will likely push p95 up. I'll sketch a concrete config and latency estimate before the enablement call.

deploy-bot: Quota change request created: ORCH-34 requested +2 Dedicated GPUs for trial. Ticket #INC-4821 — awaiting infra-ops approval.

anjali_success: I'll prep an eval harness and a minimal prompt set to monitor quality regressions during PoV. Draft will include: sample prompts, eval metrics (rerank NDCG, gen BLEU/ROUGE-ish), and alert thresholds tied to the console.

tom_sales: :thumbsup: I'll draft a 6mo pilot commercial: reserved baseline + overage pricing and a potential uplift for longer commit. Want to review numbers with @kevin_serving and @anjali_success before sending. Can we sync by EOD tomorrow?

maria_cs: Thanks team — action items: @kevin_serving = config + latency estimate, @anjali_success = enablement + eval harness, @tom_sales = draft commercial. I'll follow up after the 4/12 call. :slightly_smiling_face:
